LANCEROTTENSE (Praeger) Praeger, 1928 兰萨/刃之舞
"lancerottense"意为"Of or from Lanzarote, Canary Islands(源自兰萨罗特岛,加那利群岛.)"以其叶为倒披针形(oblanceolate)拟名刃之舞,另音译一名兰萨.

From:wikimedia
Synonym :
异名:
Sempervivum lancerottense Praeger (1925)
Section Aeonium
莲花掌组
Distribution : Canary Islands (Lanzarote); 200 - 600 m.
分布:加那利群岛(兰萨罗特岛);海拔200 - 600m.
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003):
Perennial densely branched subshrubs to 60 cm.
多年生亚灌木,易群生,成株可达60cm.
Branches ascending, 7 - 15 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.
分枝上升,直径7 - 15mm,无毛,呈网状.
Rosettes 10 - 18 cm in diameter, rather flattish.
莲座直径10 - 18cm,叶尖持平.
Leaves 5 - 9 x 1.5 - 4 cm, 3 - 6 mm thick, obovate- or oblanceolate-spatulate, apically acute, caudate, basally cuneate, glaucous, glabrate, margin with some wrinkled cilia in the upper part, green to yellowish-green, often reddish variegated along margin and at the apex.
叶长5 - 9cm,宽1.5 - 4cm,厚3 - 6mm,叶呈倒卵形或倒披针形,匙形,先端急尖,尾状,基部楔形,叶被白霜,光滑,边缘有一些起皱的纤毛,叶呈绿色至黄绿色,沿微和尖顶常有杂色.
Inflorescences dome-shaped, 8 - 30 x 8 - 25 cm, peduncle 6 - 20 cm, pedicels 1 - 3.5 mm, glabrous.
圆顶形花序,高8 - 30cm,宽8 - 26cm,总花梗长6 - 20cm,花梗长1 - 3.5mm,无毛.
Flowers 7- to 8-merous, sepals puberulent to glabrate, petals 6 - 9 x 1 - 1.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, median part pinkish variegated, filaments glabrous.
花基数7 - 8,萼片被微柔毛到光滑,花瓣长6 - 9mm,宽1 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,花瓣中心有以粉红色为主的杂色,花丝无毛.
Cytology : n=18
染色体:n=18

©terraincognitaAeonium lancerottense 刃之舞 是Aeonium中十分有特色的品种,其鲜嫩的叶色和其刀刃般锋利的叶形形成了鲜明的对比,并且其花开时的盛状十分有观赏性,值得收藏.
